description: Yantravese – a zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework with native ESM, TypeScript support, and edge‑ready routing that outpaces Express and Fastify.
npm_trending_strategy: Position Yantravese as the go‑to "Express‑compatible but faster" solution for modern serverless and edge deployments. Highlight its zero‑dependency core, native ESM, built‑in TypeScript definitions, and out‑of‑the‑box security middleware. Leverage trending 2026 buzzwords (edge, serverless, micro‑services, AI‑ready) in the README and tags, and promote the daily‑release model that guarantees cutting‑edge performance fixes.
download_hooks: Zero‑dependency core delivers sub‑millisecond routing, beating Express by 5‑10x and Fastify by 2‑3x in real‑world benchmarks.
Built‑in async middleware, native TypeScript typings, and out‑of‑the‑box security let you ship features faster with fewer bugs.
Single‑file install, native ESM, and edge‑ready APIs keep your dev setup trivial and CI pipelines lean.
